scheme_name: Nirman Shramikon ke Liye Vyavsayik Rin Par Byaj ki Punarbharan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the board and regularly deposit contributions
Loan amount can be used only for the applicant's own business work and cannot be used for purchase of shop, plot, vehicle, or household goods
Applicant must submit a certificate of intention to repay interest to the financial institution every year
Scheme is applicable only on the loan taken by one of the registered beneficiary's wife or husband at a time
If any information provided in the application is found to be false, the beneficiary must deposit the entire sanctioned assistance amount along with interest in lump sum
benefits_summary: The scheme reimburses interest on business loans up to ₹5,00,000.
documents_required: Certificate of intention to repay interest
